location.story: The Wise Goat And The Wolf

approved_translation: Wisdom and alertness can outwit brute force; the clever survive where the strong perish.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time, many, many wild Goats lived in a cave in the side of a hill. A Wolf lived with his mate not far from this cave. She turned, and away she ran back to her mate. The Goat never saw either of them again.
interpretation_boundaries: Do not depict specific historical Buddha figures — keep characters as generic animals or people
